requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:48 matches the contract `send(string $title, string $message, array $context = []): void`. :52-54 return early when the URL is null or ''. :57-61 POST {content} with `Http::timeout(5)`. :86 truncates with `mb_substr(..., 0, 1800, 'UTF-8')`. :121-132 redact sensitive keys and bearer credentials, :103-104 recurse into nested arrays, :136-139 render them as JSON. :63-72 log errors for non-2xx responses and caught Throwables, with the URL scrubbed. config/logging.php:181 makes the stack default 'daily'. config/logging.php:189-195 adds the audit channel (daily, audit.log, info, 90). There is no discord channel. config/services.php:208-210 adds the webhook config. .env.example:10-18 and phpunit.xml:309 are updated. The `daily` channel itself is not in the diff, so the LOG_DAILY_DAYS=14 requirement depends on the existing config. Scrubbing only replaces the exact URL string, so an encoded or partial form of the URL in an exception message would get through.

conventions.evidence: Conventions say 'No production code without a test; everything implemented ships with a test', but the diff has no test files. conventions.md links to `docs/ops/logging.md`, but the change creates docs/ops/observability.md, so that link stays broken. There is no CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased], which the docs-sync convention asks for. PHPDoc on the public method is present (DiscordOpsAlert.php:45-47).

security.evidence: Values are redacted by sensitive key (regex `password|token|secret|authorization|api[\s_-]?key|webhook`, case-insensitive, :124) and by bearer pattern (:131), including in nested arrays. Log context has only the status code (:65) or the scrubbed exception message (:70). Remaining gap: scrub() (:163-170) uses `str_replace` on the exact URL only, so a URL-encoded or truncated form of the webhook token in an exception message would still be logged.

tests.evidence: The diff has no Pest/PHPUnit test. Nothing covers the no-op when the URL is unset, the payload format, the 1800-character truncation, redaction (keys, bearer, nested), the non-2xx and exception logging, URL scrubbing, or the logging config contract. The only test-related edit is the env pin at phpunit.xml:309.

simplicity.evidence: The class is direct and uses only Laravel's Http and Log facades, with no extra layers. Small redundancies: stringify() (:134-157) has two identical json_encode branches (array and fallback). scrub() checks `$webhookUrl === ''` (:165), which can never be true because send() already returned for an empty URL. `->asJson()` is the client's default.

readability.evidence: Methods are small and well named (format, redact, isSensitiveKey, containsBearerCredential, stringify, scrub), with short docblocks. The config additions match the existing channel style (`'replace_placeholders' => true`). The unreachable empty-string guard in scrub() is minor dead code.

scope.evidence: Every changed file serves the task: .env.example, the notifier class, config/logging.php, config/services.php, docs/ops/observability.md and phpunit.xml. The notifier is not wired into any job or handler, which is out of scope as required.

issues.explanation: The new notifier and logging channels ship with no tests, which breaks the mandatory test-first convention and leaves truncation, redaction, soft-fail logging and URL scrubbing unverified.
conventions.md links to `docs/ops/logging.md` for the logging guidance, but the doc was created under a different name, so that link is broken.
There is no CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry for the new notifier and logging channels, which the docs-sync convention requires.
scrub() only replaces the exact webhook URL string, so a URL-encoded or partial form of the token in a transport exception message would still be logged.
The diff does not touch the `daily` channel, so the 14-day retention via LOG_DAILY_DAYS depends on the existing config being correct, and the change does not verify it.
stringify() has two identical json_encode branches that could be merged.
The empty-URL guard in scrub() can never run because send() already returns early for an empty URL.

review.summary: The change adds a clean, soft-failing DiscordOpsAlert with recursive redaction, multibyte-safe truncation and URL scrubbing, plus the audit channel, a daily stack default, env keys and a lanes doc. Functionally it covers nearly all requirements. It ships with no tests at all, which breaks the project's mandatory TDD convention, and it misses the CHANGELOG entry and the expected docs/ops/logging.md name, so it needs changes before merging.
